### Taking Opportunities
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/taking-opportunities-one-year-devotions-for-men-december-26.html
Passage: Acts 26:28-29
Points:
- Paul saw his trial in chains not as a defeat, but as an opportunity to point his listeners to Christ.
- Even when rudely accused of madness, Paul responded with calm courtesy and dignity.
- His witness centered on his personal encounter with the risen Lord rather than dry debate.
- Believers are called to share the gospel with clarity and conviction, leaving the final outcome to God.

### Day 289: Acts 26:24–32
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-289-acts-26-2432.html
Passage: Acts 26:24-32
Points:
- Believers often understand God's ultimate calling, yet struggle with His timing and methods.
- Paul knew God intended him to reach Rome, but likely never anticipated doing so as an inmate.
- God often brings His plans to pass in ways human beings would never expect or design.
- When the questions of how and when remain unanswered, believers can rest securely in who God is.
